# CG-REQ-024: Request value constraint tightened

A numeric, length, size or uniqueness constraint on request values became stricter.

**Why it matters:** Whether real values fall in the excluded range is unknown, so this is policy-dependent.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.constraintChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | yes |

## Message

> `{keyword}` became stricter in {where}.
>
> Values that satisfied the old `{keyword}` may now be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the previous limit, or confirm that no consumer sends values in the excluded range.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: maxLength 100 → 50

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 100}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. `maxLength` became stricter in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: minimum → exclusiveMinimum (number)

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number, minimum: 0}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. `minimum` became stricter in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: multipleOf 2 → 4

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, multipleOf: 2}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, multipleOf: 4}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. `multipleOf` became stricter in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: integer minimum 1 ↔ exclusiveMinimum 0

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, exclusiveMinimum: 0}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: maxLength 50 → 100

```diff

    /x:

-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}

```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Real consumer values near the boundary are unknown.
